resources.string: Configures what traffic goes into the tunnel
Configures how your device connects to the server
Use a custom DNS server. Leave empty to use defaults. Warning! DNS queries will always bypass VPN.
Choose which apps will use the tunnel and which will connect directly. By default, all apps are included in the tunnel

Resolve domain names on the proxy server side instead of locally (fake IP mode). DNS queries are answered locally from a fake IP pool, and connections are forwarded to the SOCKS5 server by domain name. The DNS Resolver IP above is ignored. Requires the remote DNS tun2socks build (see .github/workflows/build-tun2socks-aar.yml).
